name: Crunchy Top Ham and Potato Casserole
description: A hearty ham and potato casserole with a crunchy corn flake topping.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all casserole ingredients and mix well.
Place the mixture in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine topping ingredients (melted butter and crushed corn flakes) and sprinkle on top of the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

keywords: ham and potato casserole, crunchy topping, comforting casserole

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Spaghetti Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty spaghetti casserole with ground beef, canned tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of mushroom soup

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef and onion in a frying pan.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Transfer cooked spaghetti to a 2-quart casserole dish.
Pour canned tomatoes over the spaghetti layer.
Spoon the browned meat mixture over the tomatoes.
Cover with cream of mushroom soup.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes, uncovered, until cheese starts to get bubbly.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti casserole, ground beef, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Meat and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole with ground beef, sliced potatoes, and corn, topped with a savory gravy.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer sliced potatoes in an 8L casserole dish.
Mix the gravy mix with 1 cup water and pour over the potatoes. Add remaining water.
Top with corn and the browned meat mixture.
Cover and cook at 350°F for 50 minutes.

_similar.keywords: meat casserole, potato and corn dish, gravy topping

_similar.name: Ham & Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A layered ham, potato, and cheese casserole cooked in a slow cooker.
recipeIngredient: Cream of mushroom or celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Put half of the ham, potatoes, onions, cheese, salt, and pepper in a slow cooker.
Add the remaining half of the ingredients for the second layer.
Top with soup and sprinkle with paprika.
Cook on slow for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 hours.

_similar.name: Creamy Beef and Potato Bake
_similar.description: A layered casserole featuring ground beef, potatoes, zucchini, and a creamy cheddar sauce.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup prepared tomato pasta sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F to 375°F.
In a skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter and oil over medium-low heat. Add potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add zucchini, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook until zucchini is tender.
Spoon the vegetable mixture into a 13x9 inch baking dish. Set aside.
In the same skillet, cook onion and Italian seasoning until onion is tender.
Add ground beef to the skillet and cook until it loses its pink color. Stir in tomato sauce and ½ cup milk.
Spoon the meat mixture over the vegetable layer in the baking dish.
Melt remaining butter in the skillet, stir in flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in remaining milk. Cook and stir until the sauce thickens.
Stir in cheddar cheese until melted. Pour the sauce over the meat layer.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, potato bake, creamy sauce
